caseName: Delaware Tribal Business Committee v. Weeks

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. W. D. Okla. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one and one-half hours allotted for oral argument. In case No. 75-1335, the parties are invited to address particularly questions 1, 4, and 9 presented by the jurisdictional statement. Reported below: 406 F. Supp. 1309.
